intervals.binomial: Wilson score; accuracy and per-label precision/recall
intervals.bootstrap_note: Resample whole human/model pairs within each observed human-label stratum, preserving original supports and missing predictions. Fixed observed human/prediction union defines macro F1; prediction-only labels contribute zero when absent in a draw. Intervals condition on the observed human-label prevalence.

definitions.accuracy: correct / labelled; every valid human-labelled row is retained and missing model labels count as wrong
definitions.accuracy_all_labelled: correct / labelled; a missing model label counts as wrong
definitions.accuracy_available_predictions: Diagnostic only: correct / rows with an available model label
definitions.specific_accuracy: correct / specific_n; specific_n = all valid human-labelled rows whose label is not other/unclear, including missing predictions
definitions.precision: tp / predicted for that label among valid human-labelled rows
definitions.recall: tp / all human support for that label; missing predictions count as false negatives
definitions.macro_f1: Unweighted mean F1 over the fixed observed human/prediction label union; prediction-only labels contribute zero
definitions.macro_f1_human_supported: Supplementary mean F1 over labels with human support only
definitions.confusion: rows = human label, columns = model label plus __missing_prediction__; total equals all valid human-labelled rows
